verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at code.claude.com/llms.txt and agent-fetchable Markdown versions of the docs pages (e.g. skills.md), each opening with a pointer to the full documentation index. Other docs, such as the platform skills guide and the agentskills.io specification, are also served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: a Skills-specific llms.txt (the probed one covers Claude Code docs broadly), and independent hands-on corroboration that agents use these docs effectively.
